result.title: AIRRI: Towards a Human-Readable, Machine-Resistant Reading Interface
result.summary: The rapid advancement of image-to-text extraction systems and large language models (LLMs) poses new challenges for educational assessment by making assignment materials easy to transcribe and solve with minimal human effort. To address this problem, we present AIRRI (Artificial Intelligence Resilient Reading Interface), a framework for generating machine-resistant educational content, a dataset of higher-education assignments for evaluation, and an initial evaluation of the human readability of AIRRI machine-resistant text designs. AIRRI employs two categories of machine-resistance techniques. First, AIRRI applies image transformations including character spacing, word spacing, line spacing, character opacity variation, stripe overlays, and image noise. Second, AIRRI applies decision-based adversarial attacks: RayS, SurFree, and ADBA. We evaluate AIRRI against three image-to-text systems: Tesseract, EasyOCR, and the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our results show that AIRRI substantially degrades automated text extraction performance. AIRRI increased character error rates for EasyOCR (6.9% to 55.9%), Tesseract (2.3% to 100.0%), and GOT-OCR2 (30.7% to 48.1%). Word error rates increased for EasyOCR (24.9% to 96.7%) and Tesseract (10.7% to 100.0%). Among the evaluated decision-based attacks, ADBA consistently produced the largest degradation in image-to-text performance, while RayS and SurFree produced more moderate reductions. EasyOCR and Tesseract were generally more susceptible to both image-based and adversarial perturbations than the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our findings suggest that AIRRI can significantly reduce the reliability of image-to-text-to-LLM workflows, increasing the effort required for AI-assisted assignment completion.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AIRRI 框架，用图像变换（字距、行距、透明度、条纹叠加、噪声）与决策式对抗攻击（RayS、SurFree、ADBA）生成「抗机器读取」的教育作业内容，并在 Tesseract、EasyOCR、GOT-OCR2 上评估文本提取性能下降程度及人类可读性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其通过扰动视觉输入来削弱自动文本提取的做法，可能可供核查作为探测多模态模型是否真正依赖像素证据、筛选必要视觉细节的手段；但论文聚焦 OCR 鲁棒性与作业防 AI 抄袭，与 latent 推理状态的生成和使用无直接联系。
